From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Omar Khayyám (1048–1131), Rubáiyát (Persian), in the English version of Edward FitzGerald (1809–1883), 1859, in the fifth edition of 1889. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution.
